# Mohammed Elmahfoudi

> Mohammed Elmahfoudi — software engineer building backend systems, APIs, and containerized infrastructure with Python, TypeScript, and C++.

I build backend systems, production APIs, and containerized infrastructure. From HTTP servers in C++ to full-stack platforms in Python and TypeScript, I enjoy understanding how things work from the ground up.

Currently: now · backend developer @ SHBM INF Platform.
Based in: Morocco.

## Projects

- [Webserv — HTTP Server from Scratch](https://github.com/maelmahf/Webserv): Built an HTTP/1.1 server in C++98 with a single-threaded, non-blocking poll() event loop. Supports virtual hosts, location-based routing, asynchronous CGI execution, uploads, persistent connections, and HTTP range requests.
- [Inception — Containerized Infrastructure](https://github.com/maelmahf/inception): Orchestrated NGINX, WordPress, MariaDB, and Redis with Docker Compose. Configured TLS, isolated service networking, and persistent volumes, with Adminer and Portainer for administration.
- [Minishell — Unix Shell](https://github.com/maelmahf/mini_shel): A shell implementation in C with an execution tree, environment-variable expansion, wildcard expansion, quote handling, heredoc handling, and signal management.
- [Philosophers — Concurrency Simulation](https://github.com/maelmahf/Philo): A dining philosophers simulation in C exploring threads, shared state, mutex synchronization, meal timing, and monitoring.
- [Gymbot — Booking Automation](https://github.com/maelmahf/book): A Python automation project that books recurring gym sessions. Includes Docker-based deployment and scheduled execution on Railway.
- [Cub3D](https://github.com/maelmahf/Cub3D): A C graphics project from the 42 curriculum.
- [Push_swap](https://github.com/maelmahf/Push_swap): A C sorting project from the 42 curriculum, built around stack operations.
- [Pipex — Command Pipelines](https://github.com/maelmahf/PIPEX): Recreates command pipelines in C, connecting commands through Unix pipes.
- [So_long — MiniLibX Game](https://github.com/maelmahf/so_long): A small game written in C using the MiniLibX graphics library.
- [C++ Modules 00–09](https://github.com/maelmahf/CPP00-09): A collection of C++ curriculum modules and programming exercises.
- [Libft — C Library](https://github.com/maelmahf/Libft): A personal C library developed as part of the 42 curriculum.
- [Ft_printf](https://github.com/maelmahf/Printf): A C implementation of formatted output from the 42 curriculum.
- [Get Next Line](https://github.com/maelmahf/Get-Next-Line): A C utility for reading input one line at a time.
- Ft_Transcendence — Full-Stack Web Platform: Built a platform with Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Implemented candidate and recruiter roles, JWT sessions, protected routing, an AI-powered recommendation API, and recruiter offer management with live UI updates.
- [Sahtek — Web Interface](https://github.com/maelmahf/Sahtek): A web interface with a landing page, login page, and dashboard, built with HTML and supporting assets.
